title: Winter weather and fireside life
summary: She describes cold winters, no field work, planting cane in January, and sitting by the fire.

Did you work in the fields in the winter too?

No, no. No, they took a lot. They didn't work in the wintertime. It was cold. What did you do in the winter? I'd stay home to the fire. But they couldn't do nothing when they had all that ice. When they used to have that ice, you know. But after that, we'd plant can. In January and February, they'd plant can. Set the props. January and February, but in December, it would be so cold all that whole month. We couldn't do nothing but stay home to the fire. March. Sometimes it would be so cold in March.
